invariants: Application composition and reusable module authority remain separate.
Unlisted, denied, stale-lock, or off-lock features are inert before permission, scene, input, marker, media, or platform effects.
One mutable parameter has one runtime authority; adapters project requests and owner-issued receipts without manufacturing acceptance.
Stable modules require an independent consumer or neutral conformance harness.
The Ready automation action is the only portable mutation path from proposed to claimable and requires accepted prerequisites plus an additive event.
At most one effective iteration unit is active or validating; immutable historical in-flight state is superseded only by an exact additive transition event.
Validation and acceptance require exact repository revisions, changed paths, criterion and gate coverage, hash-bound artifacts, and device cleanup/fatal evidence when required.
Automation inspects or plans by default and never owns Git push, force-push, checkout/reset/stash, validation execution, or device mutation.

Prepared push plans are not execution evidence; an executed receipt may bind a pre-publication capture and hash-bound validation files and records ancestry, old/new/readback refs, source-first order, planning-last order, no-force proof, and rollback anchors.
Instruction-triggering units synchronize AGENTS, a README/router, relevant installed skills, and portable skill copies before acceptance.
